name: vm_native_q1_ref-nat2-COMMIT
purpose: Native v16 ABI master for SE/NE (RG4/WG2; die netlist main 04fad9220 binds hfd_vms_bank_native_q*, strap masters retired). Same body as strap6: strap5 write tree (payload zeroed at its own pin capture, lv_rep removed), SECDED flip on the D edge. nat2: recipe-3 pin register on every input (+1 edge per input, uniform; native q2 nat1 TT -59.5 = 35 input->reg endpoints, valid pin -> ~281 masking ANDs; reg->reg +60.5), outputs stay RTL registers, EG_WIDE=1 (strap5 q0 TT -114.94: 21/22 violators packet/COLL leaf -> egress pin clones; native q2 gate nat1 placement reg->reg -115.9 at eg_d[10], same egress pattern; equivalence 0 mismatches at RG5/WG2, RG4/WG2, RG5/WG3). Pins: v4 strap grant N/S/W + E face = strap q2 E (0.144 um) minus rq5/rr5 (results/arch/hbm_die_v16/vm_native_bank_grants_0600.json).
